## How to write and review the job

Use the platform renderer: bind the exact registry plugin version to a workflow node, fill canonical inputs, open the LSF preview, and review `#BSUB`, staging directories, runtime setup and the final command before submission.
This plugin intentionally has no second hand-written command catalog; the ModelPlugin snapshot is the command source.

Plugin-specific checks:

- The native BDA 2024.09-bda.1 workbench supports seven modes and 45 documented parameters; see [PLUGIN_GUIDE.md](./PLUGIN_GUIDE.md). It requires single-model PDB with explicit chain mapping; legacy format support is version-specific.
- The reviewed binary is non-MPI and must not request extra CPU slots without measured parallel work outside the binary.
- Count decoys and score rows before run_complete; LSF Successfully completed is not sufficient.
- The new native runner exports per-run parameter explanations, raw metrics and optional interface geometry; runtime status remains unproven until a real Rosetta run verifies this exact declaration.

The authorized submission order is `validate → render/preview → review → stage → review → bsub`. Queue selection is made from a current `bqueues` check; do not copy another job's queue or CPU count.
